As of now, OpenAI’s latest flagship large language model is **GPT-4o**, released in May 2024.

Key features of GPT-4o include:
- **Multimodal capabilities**: Native support for text, audio, and vision (real-time voice conversations, image understanding, and text generation).
- **Faster and more efficient**: Significantly lower latency and improved response times—especially for voice interactions—compared to previous models like GPT-4 Turbo.
- **Enhanced reasoning and multilingual performance**: Stronger accuracy, coding ability, and support for over 50 languages.
- **Free access**: GPT-4o is available for free to all users (with usage limits), while higher-tier tiers (e.g., ChatGPT Plus) offer increased usage caps and priority access.

⚠️ Note: OpenAI has not officially announced a successor to GPT-4o as of **June 2024**, and there is no confirmed "GPT-5" release yet. Rumors or speculation about GPT-5 are unverified and not supported by official OpenAI communications.

For the most up-to-date information, always refer to the official [OpenAI blog](https://openai.com/blog) or their [model documentation](https://platform.openai.com/docs/models).
